description: Controlled 10-task scaling benchmark testing candidate budgets 20, 40, and 60 across 7 distinct transformation families: fractal expansion, morphological hole-filling, periodic reflection tiling, relational coloring, multi-region structures, rigid geometry (rot/flip), color mapping, gravity extrusion, and dimension reduction.
selection_methodology: Includes all 5 tasks from the Phase 1 acceptance manifest plus 5 diverse, non-duplicate tasks selected from the official training split to probe scaling behavior across varied spatial, topological, and geometric invariants without task selection bias.
ground_truth_isolation_protocol: During solving, inference, memory retrieval, and candidate generation, the solver has access STRICTLY to training pairs and test input grids. Ground truth test solution grids are withheld in a separate evaluation harness and evaluated only after predictions are written to disk.

tasks.description: Kronecker fractal expansion where non-zero pattern cells expand into complete copies of the input subgrid.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Retained from 5-task acceptance suite. Tests dimension expansion and recursive structural composition.

tasks.description: Interior enclosed voids (0-holes) surrounded by non-zero boundary pixels are filled with a newly introduced color (4).
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Retained from 5-task acceptance suite. Tests morphological hole detection and relational parameterization of new colors.

tasks.description: Tiling subgrid into a 3x3 repetition with alternating vertical reflections across horizontal neighbors.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Retained from 5-task acceptance suite. Tests periodic reflection tiling and composite dimension expansion.

tasks.description: Relational color assignment conditioned on foreground component structure and spatial adjacency.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Retained from 5-task acceptance suite. Unsolved at budget 20; tests whether higher candidate budgets enable depth-3 composition.

tasks.description: Multi-region interior filling conditioned on component area and boundary enclosure.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Retained from 5-task acceptance suite. Unsolved at budget 20; tests multi-region topological partitioning under budget scaling.
Tests whether basic rigid isometric rotations are cleanly discovered and verified at low candidate budgets.

tasks.description: Rigid geometric vertical reflection (flip_v) across horizontal axis.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Tests pure reflectional symmetry discovery on multi-color 5x5 grids.

tasks.description: Global color replacement mapping color 7 to color 5 while preserving all other foreground and background values across varying grid shapes.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Tests variable-dimension color mapping and relational color substitution.

tasks.description: Directional downwards gravity/extrusion projecting non-zero pixels down to the bottom border.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Tests directional physics-style movement and column-wise projection rules.

tasks.description: Identifies dominant nested rectangular outline among background objects and abstracts it into a uniform 2x2 color block.
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Tests dimension reduction, object abstraction, and filtering of nested bounding boxes.
